name: "Outstanding Artisan of the Year" under “Motivation of Entrepreneurs to Start Industries and Fiscal Assistance to Industries - State Awards to Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises”
benefit: Cash Award of ₹2,00,000/- and a Citation.
_eligibility_text:
- The applicant should be an Artisan.
- The applicant should have been a participant for 3 years in National / International handicraft exhibitions/fairs.
